outcome: Type of infant feeding (exclusive breastfeeding, artificial feeding, mixed feeding)
cohort: 827 mother-infant dyads with infants older than 6 months
finding: Several factors were associated with artificial feeding rather than exclusive breastfeeding, including younger maternal age, higher child birth order, primiparity, single marital status, preterm infant, and complicated labor.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with mixed feeding.
